name: JK Shiiku ~Junpaku no Shojo ni Midara na Kioku o Ataeru Otoko~
original_name: JK飼育 ～純白の処女に淫らな記憶を与える男～
source:
After losing your beloved pet, you've been feeling down. On your way home, you stumble across a high school girl with amnesia. 
You can't just leave her there, so being the kind-hearted person you are, you take her back to your apartment. 
That night, unsure of who she is or where to go, she offers the only thing she has—her body—as thanks for taking her in. 
To comfort the anxious girl and satisfy your own (healthy) desires, you decide to take her virginity. 
You give her a name, and the two of you begin a sort of weird cohabiting. 

With nowhere else to go, the innocent high school girl has no choice but to stay in your apartment. 
You can't let this opportunity go to waste! 
As you mold her into your ideal companion, you also search for clues about her past. 
Depending on what you find, you might uncover her surprising true identity…

translation:
失去心爱的宠物后，你一直情绪低落。回家路上，你遇到了一个失忆的高中女生。
你不能就这样丢下她，出于好心，你把她带回了自己的公寓。
那晚，她不知道自己是谁、该去哪里，便用自己唯一拥有的东西——身体——作为收留她的谢礼。
为了安慰这个焦虑的女孩并满足自己（正常的）欲望，你夺走了她的童贞。
你给她取了一个名字，两人开始了奇特的同居生活。

无处可去的纯真高中女生只能住在你的公寓里。
你不能浪费这个机会！
在将她塑造成理想伴侣的同时，你也寻找着她过去的线索。
根据你的发现，也许能揭开她惊人的真正身份……
